notes.title: The Hellbrand is part of The Mix 10th Anniversary Showcase!
notes.notes:
Hello!

Hidden Titan are very pleased to be celebrating The Mix 10th anniversary today as part of Black Voices in Gaming.
You can watch our CEO & Game Director talk a bit about the game with Black Voices in Gaming from 1:15pm Pacfic (21:15 CET) live on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/mediaindieexchange]Twitch[/url]

Black Voices in Gaming are dedicated to highlighting Black voices in the gaming industry, dedicated exclusively to presenting games created by Black developers, titles featuring Black protagonists, and conversations with these creators.

Also, live on the stream will be the [i][b]first time[/b][/i] anyone outside the company will have hands on time with the game!

Our planned development road is long but if you like what you see on the store page so far, please Wishlist the game and tell [i][b]ALL[/b][/i] of your friends!

We'll be going a bit quiet after the event but if you want to keep up with all things The Hellbrand, 
[list]
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/HiddenTitanDE]Follow us on Twitter![/url]
[*] [url=www.hiddentitan.com]Sign up for our newsletter![/url]
[/list]
Thanks for checking out The Hellbrand.

~the TITANS

notes.title: The Hellbrand is part of the Games Germany Steam Event!
notes.notes:

You probably haven't heard of Hidden Titan before but we have been spending the last six months working on our first game, The Hellbrand. We don't have much to show you at the moment but we heard this Games Germany event was on and couldn't resist peeking out of the shadows.

We have a long development journey ahead of us but if you like what you see on the store page so far, please Wishlist the game. (and tell your friends!)
